description: Edges that neither Docker Compose nor appsettings can express. Compose records only container start order; appsettings.Production.json gives REST, database, mail and logging targets. What is left is the RabbitMQ event topology - which service publishes which event and who consumes it - and that only exists in the handler code, so it is recorded here.

notes.auditlogservice: Logs every message type it receives rather than switching on a known set, so it is modelled as a wildcard subscriber.
notes.webapp: The only user-facing entry point. A module page renders an offline placeholder when its API is unreachable, which is what the chaos probes assert on.
